senses.zh: 用全麦做的；用全麦面粉做的
senses.en: (BrE wholemeal)
examples: The cool temperature helps keep [[whole wheat]] flour fresh for longer.

senses.en: cook under or over direct heat
examples: The meat tastes best when you [[grill]] it for 20 minutes on each side.

senses.en: make (bread, cheese, etc.) brown by placing it close to heat
examples: [[Toast]] the bread lightly on both sides and it will be ready.

senses.en: bread that has been heated so that it is brown on both sides and no longer soft
examples: I'd like a coffee and two slices of [[toast]] with butter.

senses.en: a person who studies history and / or writes about it
examples: His father is a famous [[historian]], specializing in the history of Germany.

senses.en: the quality of being good at finding ways to deal with difficult situations
examples: Because of his adventures, he is a person of far greater experience and [[resourcefulness]].

senses.en: the process of entering another country to make one's life there
examples: The government has decided to tighten the [[immigration]] policy.

senses.en: (BrE also globalisation) the process of making sth. such as a business operate in a lot of different countries all around the world, or the result of this
examples: Economic [[globalization]] has changed the nature of competition among cities in developing countries.

senses.en: (pl. tuna or tunas)
(fml.) (~ from / in) come from a particular place or start in a particular situation
examples: All theories [[originate]] from practice and in turn serve practice.

senses.en: reduce the amount of money, time, goods, etc. that you use
examples: He tried to [[conserve]] on fuel during the long winter.

senses.en: keep sth. from being wasted, damaged, lost, or destroyed
examples: We must [[conserve]] our forests and woodlands for our future generations.

senses.en: a larger amount of sth. than is allowed or needed
examples: The test revealed an [[excess]] of alcohol in the driver's blood.

senses.en: (~s) food remaining uneaten after a meal
examples: At my grandma's, we sometimes had [[leftovers]] and it was my grandpa who ate them.

senses.zh: 未用完的；剩余的；未吃完的
senses.en: (only before noun) remaining after all the rest has been used, taken, or eaten
examples: This recipe makes use of [[leftover]] chicken from the roast chicken recipe.

senses.en: behavior and attitudes that most people in a society consider to be normal and right
examples: It is a matter of [[convention]] that businessmen should wear suits.

senses.en: a large formal meeting for people who belong to the same profession or organization or who have the same interests
examples: They have chosen him to represent their city at the [[convention]].

senses.zh: （货物、人员等的）流动，流通；吞吐
senses.en: movement (as of goods or people) into, through, and out of a place
examples: The restaurant did a lively business and had a rapid [[turnover]].

senses.en: (BrE) the amount of business done during a particular period
examples: I believe they've doubled their [[turnover]] since those advertisements appeared in the press.

senses.en: (of food) preserved in a tin
examples: They tend to buy cheap processed foods like [[canned]] chicken.

senses.en: the disadvantage or negative aspect of sth.
examples: There is a [[downside]] of living in the countryside: It takes a long time to commute to work.

senses.en: the state of being liked, enjoyed, or supported by a large number of people
examples: We are doing a weekly poll on the president, and clearly his [[popularity]] has declined.

senses.en: not deliberate
examples: Technological advances are sometimes accompanied by [[unintended]] consequences such as pollution and global warming.

senses.en: (~s) food left after a meal
examples: The rats run around, searching for [[scraps]] in the rubbish.

senses.en: a small piece of paper, cloth, etc.
examples: He wrote his address on a [[scrap]] of paper.

senses.en: the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is morally right or wrong
examples: I have battled with my [[conscience]] over whether I should actually send this letter.

senses.en: the study of the environment and the belief that it must be protected from damage by human activities
examples: The teacher asked the students to find more information on [[environmentalism]] on the Internet.

senses.en: a group of people who have a lot of power and influence because they have money, knowledge, or special skills
examples: In this country, only the [[elite]] can afford an education for their children.

senses.en: a metal pan over a heater, used to cook or to keep things warm at the table
examples: Last Friday I got back to town and had [[chafing dishes]] with my family members.

senses.en: the act of combining or state of being combined
examples: After running through the numbers in every possible [[combination]], we finally hit on a solution.

senses.en: two or more things joined or mixed together to form a single unit
examples: The best approach may well be to use a [[combination]] of both methods.

senses.en: the quality of being attractive and showing a good sense of style
examples: In the dining room the decoration creates an atmosphere of [[elegance]].

senses.en: lasting or intended to last for a long time or forever
examples: Heavy drinking can cause [[permanent]] damage to the brain.

senses.en: food cooked in a certain way
examples: The dining room has lakeside views and offers excellent [[cuisine]].

senses.en: a particular style of cooking
examples: Chinese [[cuisine]] is an art, which grew out of a highly developed civilization.

senses.en: not liking changes or new ideas
examples: The young people are the most eager to learn and the least [[conservative]] in their thinking.

senses.en: dislike of changes or new ideas
examples: Jones himself was a curious mixture of radicalism (激进主义) and [[conservatism]].

senses.en: the quality of remaining faithful to your friends, principles, country, etc.
examples: I was deeply impressed by his [[loyalty]] to his brother.

senses.en: small, pretty, and delicate
examples: We visited her uncle's place and were given tea and some [[dainty]] little cakes.

senses.en: a university degree of the highest level
examples: He received his [[doctorate]] in political science at Columbia University.

senses.zh: 神秘的事；不可思议的事
senses.en: sth. which cannot be explained or understood
examples: It's a [[mystery]] to me how she ever passed that exam.

senses.en: for the stated kind and no other; particularly
examples: I asked her to repeat [[specifically]] the words that Patti had used.

senses.en: (BrE also bap)
(BrE)
of a very typical and well-known kind
examples: Too many job hunters make the [[classic]] mistake of thinking only about what's in it for them.

senses.en: of the highest quality or class and esp. serving as a model
examples: Huckleberry Finn is a [[classic]] children's movie.

senses.en: (of food) making one's stomach feel full
examples: Although it is tasty, crab is not very [[filling]].

senses.zh: 大声嚼，用力嚼（尤其硬或干的食物）
senses.en: eat sth. steadily and often noisily, esp. sth. hard and / or dry
examples: The horse was [[munching]] away at my hat.

senses.en: (esp. BrE)
(infml.) a person living in a foreign country
examples: I had the vague idea that I could now vote electronically, but in fact no [[expat]] can do so.

senses.en: ask sb. for help
examples: She urged him to [[reach out to]] his family.

senses.en: that you choose by yourself
examples: Meals on a tour like ours could be eaten in any restaurant of one's [[choosing]].

senses.en: (make you) eat enough food so that you no longer feel hungry
examples: They [[filled]] me up with cakes and sandwiches.

senses.en: if you start sth. from scratch, you begin it without using anything that existed or was prepared before
examples: It's completely ruined, so we'll have to start from scratch.

senses.en: think of an idea, answer, etc.
examples: The airline has [[come up with]] a novel solution to the problem of jet lag.

senses.en: (AmE) (of cooked food sold in a shop) be taken away and not eaten in the shop
examples: "Two chicken dinners with corn [[to go]], please," he said in a hurry.

senses.en: need sth.
examples: This kind of work [[calls for]] a lot of patience.

senses.en: up to and including the present moment
examples: Even [[to this day]] we don't know what happened for sure.

senses.en: because of
examples: The company has had a successful year, thanks to the improvement in export sales.
